items.work: Chal Re Mana Jaau, from the film Ata Thambaycha Naay!
items.description:
Nihira won the Filmfare Award Marathi for Best Playback Singer (Female) for “Chal Re Mana Jaau” from the Marathi film *Ata Thambaycha Naay!*, directed by Shivraj Waichal. Gulraj Singh composed and produced the song and sings it with Nihira; the lyrics are by Manoj Yadav. The song marked her return to film playback singing.
Ata Thambaycha Naay! was the evening's biggest winner, including Best Film. The ceremony, held in Mumbai, premiered on Sony Marathi on 6 September 2026.
